name: dev-team
description: Test-first squad: the lead owns the spec, the reviewer owns every ticket, and the tests are written before the code by an agent that never sees it

members.role: Owns the spec check and every ticket; judges the tests against the spec and confirms the red
Turns acceptance criteria into failing tests, without sight of any implementation
Makes the failing tests pass; may add tests, may never weaken one
Documents what a ticket changed, as its last stage
